head_commit.message:
Add LiveChart diff tool for verifying nuclide data

- export_nuclides.ts: export the app's hydrated data (display values,
  isomers expanded) as JSON for comparison
- livechart_diff.py: compare against IAEA LiveChart ground states, with
  --recheck to re-fetch flagged nuclides from the single-nuclide API
  (the bulk CSV is a frozen 2023-10-18 snapshot)
- golden_set.py: side-by-side table of app / displayed / LiveChart values
- install_livechart_ground_states.md: how to regenerate ignored files
- Ignore downloaded/generated files under tools/livechart-diff and
  skip prettier on the generated golden_set.md

workflow_runs.display_title: Normalize E2E base path to match Vite build

head_commit.message:
Normalize E2E base path to match Vite build

The deploy workflow failed when base_path was entered without a
trailing slash (e.g. /nuclide). Vite normalizes the build base to
/nuclide/, but Playwright used the raw value, so tests opened the app
at / outside the service worker scope and navigator.serviceWorker.ready
never resolved. Normalize leading/trailing slashes in the Playwright
config and clarify the base_path input description.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add performance diagnostics, minimap cache and offline E2E

- ?debug=1 overlay: FPS, frame interval and render time p95, drawn
  cells/texts, LOD and camera; no rAF while idle. chart:first-frame
  performance entry. Separate `npm run test:perf` (1920x1080 Chromium,
  5 paths) with results kept in docs/performance-2026-09-27.json.
- Minimap: cached bitmap with 12% viewport fill, synced with color
  mode, theme and predicted-nuclide setting.
- E2E: diagnostics and offline revisit scenarios (service worker,
  manifest, AME details, search, reload while offline).
- CI checks the real Pages path /nuclide/ and runs format:check.
- Panel neighbor lookup uses the grid, help dialog reads the app
  version from package.json, Prettier applied, memo links point to
  my_thought.md.
- PROGRESS.md: record LOD 1 pan at ~55.9 FPS (below 60 fps target).
